AcceptanceRequest.description: Input contract of an acceptance: an optional note only (SEC-08).
AcceptanceRequest.title: AcceptanceRequest

AccessTokenRequest.description: Input contract of the login (SEC-08: unknown fields refused).
AccessTokenRequest.title: AccessTokenRequest

CandidateResponse.description: One item of the line's target sheet, offered to the reviewer.
CandidateResponse.title: CandidateResponse

CandidatesResponse.description: The line's target sheet and its items, best lexical score first.
CandidatesResponse.title: CandidatesResponse

CodingHistoryResponse.description: One coding of a line, in force or superseded, with what produced it.
CodingHistoryResponse.title: CodingHistoryResponse

CorrectionRequest.description: Input contract of a correction: an item and a note, never a control field (SEC-08).
CorrectionRequest.title: CorrectionRequest

EntityResolutionRequest.description: Input contract of an entity resolution: a verdict and a mandatory note (SEC-08).
EntityResolutionRequest.title: EntityResolutionRequest

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every refused or failed request: stable code, Portuguese message, reference.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FlagResponse.description: A flag or a note: the stable code and its Portuguese text (REQ-CNF-004, REQ-PLT-006).
FlagResponse.title: FlagResponse

HealthResponse.description: Output contract of the health check (SEC-08: explicit output model).
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

JobProgressResponse.description: Output contract of a job's progress (REQ-PLT-001, REQ-AUD-004).
JobProgressResponse.title: JobProgressResponse

ReprocessResponse.description: Output contract of a reprocessing request.
ReprocessResponse.title: ReprocessResponse

ResultLineResponse.description: One coded line as listed to the client (SEC-18: explicit projection).
ResultLineResponse.title: ResultLineResponse

ResultsPageResponse.description: One page of results. ``limit_truncated`` says the requested limit was capped.
ResultsPageResponse.title: ResultsPageResponse

ReviewResponse.description: The line's values in force after the review.
ReviewResponse.title: ReviewResponse

ReviewView.description: The review a person made of one coding.
ReviewView.title: ReviewView

SessionResponse.description: Output contract of the session check: answered only to an open credential.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

TargetSheet.description: The two catalog sheets. Routing picks exactly one (R2, REQ-MAP-001).
TargetSheet.title: TargetSheet

TokenUsageResponse.description: Tokens spent on one invoice's model calls (REQ-AUD-004).
TokenUsageResponse.title: TokenUsageResponse

UploadResponse.description: Output contract of an upload (SEC-08, SEC-18): no path, no digest, no file name.
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

APIKeyCookie.description: The session opened by POST /api/session with the access token, for people.
APIKeyCookie.name: sextante_session

APIKeyHeader.description: The key set in SEXTANTE_API_KEY, for programs. Or the session cookie.
APIKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key

get.description:
Download the job's coding as CSV or XLSX, always as an attachment (SEC-16).

The file name is generated by the server; no client text reaches the header.

Example:
    GET /api/exports/3f2a...?format=csv -> sextante-3f2a....csv

5XX.description: Failed, with a reference for support.

get.description:
Report that the process is up and which catalog version it serves.

The digest identifies the catalog content and is not a secret (D-3.9).

Example:
    GET /api/health -> {"status": "ok", "catalog_digest": "3f2a..."}

5XX.description: Failed, with a reference for support.

post.description:
Accept PDF or XLSX invoices and answer at once with the job that will code them.

The file count is checked before any content is read, and each file is read only up to
one byte past the size limit (03-seguranca.md §9.1, SEC-16).

Example:
    POST /api/invoices (multipart, field "files") -> 202 {"job_id": "...", ...}

post.description:
Resolve an ambiguous entity; the invoice is coded again from its stored text.

Needs Idempotency-Key. The denylist is never changed (REQ-REV-006).

Example:
    POST /api/invoices/3f2a.../entity-resolution {"resolution": "MATCH", "note": "..."}
